annotation_policy.authoring: Hand-annotated from source before running the engine; labels are not copied from engine output.
annotation_policy.scope: Pilot case for long-form entities, visual objects, complete phrases, facts, charts, sequence and image query composition.
annotation_policy.important_phrase_match: Exact source sentence or complete adjacent sentence span; a truncated prefix is a miss.
